champion.ezreal.title: the Prodigal Explorer
champion.ezreal.Q.desc: Fires a bolt that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit and applies on-hit effects. A hit lowers all his cooldowns by 1.5s.
champion.ezreal.W.desc: Fires an orb that marks the first enemy hit for 4s. Hitting it with an attack or ability detonates the mark for magic damage; detonating it with an ability restores 60 mana plus that ability's cost.
champion.ezreal.E.desc: Blinks up to 475 units, then fires a bolt at the nearest enemy (a marked one first) that deals magic damage.
champion.ezreal.R.desc: Fires a huge wave across the map that hits every enemy in its path for magic damage (50% against non-epic monsters).
champion.ezreal.passive.desc: Each ability hit grants +10% Attack Speed for 6s, stacking up to 5 times (each hit refreshes the duration).
champion.samira.title: the Desert Rose
champion.samira.Q.desc: Fires a shot that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit. With an enemy close in front, she slashes in an arc instead. Can critically strike for 125% damage.
champion.samira.W.desc: Spins her blade for 0.75s, slashing nearby enemies at the start and at the end for physical damage and destroying enemy missiles.
champion.samira.E.desc: Dashes 600 units, dealing magic damage to the enemies she passes through, then gains Attack Speed for 5s.
champion.samira.R.desc: Needs Style S. Fires 10 volleys over 2s at every enemy within 600 units for physical damage (25% against minions); each shot can critically strike. She is 30% slower meanwhile.
champion.samira.passive.desc: Hitting with a different type than the previous one (shot, blade, Q, W, E, R) raises her Style grade by one, from E up to S, for 6s, and each grade gives 2–3.5% Move Speed. Attacks within 200 units use the blade for bonus magic damage of 2–19 (+3.5–10.5% AD), up to doubled by the target's missing Health; W, E and the Q slash apply it too.

champion.brand.name: Brand
champion.brand.title: the Burning Vengeance
champion.brand.Q.desc: Launches a fireball that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit. An Ablaze target is stunned for 1.5s.
champion.brand.W.desc: After 0.6s, a pillar of flame erupts at the target area, dealing magic damage to enemies within 260 units. Ablaze enemies take 25% more damage.
champion.brand.E.desc: Blasts the target enemy for magic damage and spreads to enemies within 300 units of it for the same damage. The spread doubles to 600 units if the target is Ablaze.
champion.brand.R.desc: Launches a fireball that bounces between nearby enemies up to 4 times, dealing magic damage on each hit. Ablaze enemies are slowed by 30–60% for 0.25s.
champion.brand.passive.desc: Abilities apply Ablaze (up to 3 stacks, 4s): each stack burns for 2% max Health + 8–48 (by level) + 5% AP over its duration. The third stack primes a ring that explodes after 2s within 475 units for 8–12% max Health (+2% per 100 AP, capped at 270–525) + 30–150 + 20% AP, and sets everyone hit Ablaze. Kills by an ability or of an Ablaze enemy restore 20–40 mana.

champion.aphelios.name: Aphelios
champion.aphelios.title: the Weapon of the Faithful
champion.aphelios.Q.desc: Point: +4 bonus attack damage. The main weapon's ability (60 mana, 10 ammo; grows with level): Calibrum fires a long shot that marks the first enemy hit; Severum fires both weapons at nearby enemies for 1.75s and moves 25% faster; Gravitum deals magic damage to every enemy it slowed and roots them for 1s; Infernum hits a cone, then the off-hand weapon attacks each enemy hit; Crescendum deploys a sentry that attacks with the off-hand weapon.
champion.aphelios.W.desc: Point: +9% attack speed. Swaps the main and off-hand weapons.
champion.aphelios.E.desc: Point: +4.5 lethality. Shows the next weapon in the queue. Each weapon has 50 ammo: 1 per attack, 10 per weapon ability. When the main weapon runs out, it goes to the end of the queue and the next one takes its place.
champion.aphelios.R.desc: Ranks up on its own at levels 6, 11 and 16. A beam of moonlight stops on the first enemy hit and blasts enemies within 300 units for physical damage, then the main weapon attacks each of them: Calibrum marks for more damage, Severum heals 250–450, Gravitum slows 99%, Infernum deals bonus damage and splashes fire, Crescendum grants chakrams.
champion.aphelios.passive.desc: Wields a main and an off-hand weapon, with three more in reserve. Each weapon has 50 ammo: 1 per attack and 10 per weapon ability; when the main weapon runs out it goes to the end of the queue and the next one is assembled (no Phase for 1s).
boots.plating: Plating: physical hits deal 10% less damage
champion.aurelionsol.name: Aurelion Sol
champion.aurelionsol.title: The Star Forger
champion.aurelionsol.Q.desc: Launches a star that grows while Aurelion Sol stays within 650 units. It detonates when he moves away or after 5s, dealing magic damage and stunning enemies in its area for 0.55–1.1s. The bigger it grew, the more it deals (up to +50%).
champion.aurelionsol.W.desc: Passive: each star hit deals more damage. Toggle: the stars fly out to 650 units, orbit three times as fast and deal 40% more damage while it drains mana every second.
champion.aurelionsol.E.desc: Takes off for 3s toward the cast direction, flying over walls and units with 60–100% bonus Move Speed. Moving (click or arrow keys) ends the flight. He cannot attack while flying.
champion.aurelionsol.R.desc: Calls a meteor down on the target area. After 1s it lands, dealing magic damage to enemies within 450 units and knocking them up for 1s.
champion.aurelionsol.passive.desc: Three stars orbit him at 250 units, one turn every 6s, and hit every enemy they pass over for 20–120 (by level) + the W rank bonus + 25% AP magic damage (once per star per pass). Star kills restore 4–12 mana.
champion.teemo.name: Teemo
champion.teemo.title: the Swift Scout
champion.teemo.Q.desc: Fires a dart at the target enemy that deals magic damage and blinds it for 4–6s: its basic attacks miss.
champion.teemo.W.desc: Passive: Teemo has 12–28% bonus Move Speed. Active: doubles it for 3s.
champion.teemo.E.desc: Passive: Teemo's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage on-hit and poison the target, dealing magic damage every second for 4s (145% against monsters).
champion.teemo.R.desc: Tosses a mushroom to the target area (up to 3 charges). It arms after 1s and lasts 5 min; when an enemy steps on it, it explodes, dealing magic damage to enemies within 400 units and slowing them by 30–50% for 4s. A mushroom landing on another bounces forward.
champion.teemo.passive.desc: Standing still for 2s camouflages Teemo (no invisibility). While still, and for 5s after he moves, he gains 20/40/60/80% Attack Speed (levels 1/5/10/15).
champion.lux.name: Lux
champion.lux.title: the Lady of Luminosity
champion.lux.Q.desc: Fires a sphere of light that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit and roots them for 2s.
champion.lux.W.desc: Throws her wand out to 1175 units and it flies back to her. Lux gains a Shield for 2.5s when she throws it and another when it returns (they stack).
champion.lux.E.desc: Sends a singularity to the target area that slows enemies inside by 25–45% (the Slow lingers 1s after they leave). Press again to detonate it for magic damage; it detonates by itself after 5s.
champion.lux.R.desc: After 1s, fires a massive laser 3340 units long that deals magic damage to every enemy in the line. It detonates Illumination on the enemies it hits, then illuminates them again.
champion.lux.passive.desc: Damaging abilities illuminate the enemies they hit for 6s. Lux's next basic attack or Final Spark on an illuminated enemy consumes it for 30–200 (by level) + 30% AP magic damage. An illuminated enemy dying restores 10–30 mana.
champion.ziggs.name: Ziggs
champion.ziggs.title: the Hexplosives Expert
champion.ziggs.Q.desc: Throws a bomb that bounces forward up to two times and explodes on landing near an enemy or on its last bounce, dealing magic damage within 240 units.
champion.ziggs.W.desc: Hurls a charge that detonates after 4s or when pressed again, dealing magic damage within 325 units and knocking enemies back. If the blast hits Ziggs, he is thrown away from it.
champion.ziggs.E.desc: Scatters 11 proximity mines that arm after 0.5s and last 10s. Each mine deals magic damage and Slows by 10–50% for 1.5s; an enemy takes 40% damage from later mines.
champion.ziggs.R.desc: Catapults a huge bomb to the target area that deals magic damage within 525 units, 50% more in its 250-unit epicenter.
champion.ziggs.passive.desc: Every 12s (not shortened by Ability Haste) his next basic attack throws a bigger bomb for 20–160 (by level) + 50% AP bonus magic damage. Each ability cast takes 4/5/6s off that cooldown (levels 1/7/13).
champion.sivir.name: Sivir
champion.sivir.title: the Battle Mistress
champion.sivir.Q.desc: Hurls the crossblade 1250 units and it flies back to her, dealing physical damage to every enemy it passes on each way (damage grows with Critical Strike chance; 15% less per enemy hit, down to 40%, reset on the way back).
champion.sivir.W.desc: For 4s her basic attacks gain Attack Speed and bounce up to 8 times to enemies within 500 units for physical damage (each enemy at most twice; 65% against minions, executing them below 15 Health). Resets her attack timer.
champion.sivir.E.desc: A spell shield for 1.5s blocks the next enemy ability or projectile; blocking heals her (% AD +50% AP) and triggers Fleet of Foot.
champion.sivir.R.desc: Gains Move Speed for 8/10/12s. While active, every basic attack cuts the cooldowns of Q, W and E by 0.5s; killing an elite or epic monster refreshes the duration.
champion.sivir.passive.desc: Basic attacks and ability hits grant 55–75 (by level) flat Move Speed that decays over 1.5s.
champion.gangplank.name: Gangplank
champion.gangplank.title: the Saltwater Scourge
champion.gangplank.Q.desc: Shoots an enemy or a Powder Keg within 625 for physical damage. Can critically strike and applies on-hit and on-attack effects; never applies Trial by Fire. Kills by Parrrley or a Powder Keg restore 10-30 mana.
champion.gangplank.W.desc: Eats citrus: removes crowd control (castable while stunned) and heals for the amount shown +90% AP +13% missing Health.
champion.gangplank.E.desc: Places a Powder Keg (charges: 3/3/4/4/5, one every 8.5-6.5s) for 25s. It has 3 Health and loses 1 every 2/1/0.5s (by level) down to 1; your attacks and Parrrley take 1. Destroyed by you, it explodes for the attack's damage (x2 on a critical strike) ignoring 40% armor, slows for 2s and sets off connected kegs. Elite and epic monsters take bonus damage.
champion.gangplank.R.desc: Calls a bombardment anywhere: 12 waves over 8s, each dealing magic damage to every enemy in the area and slowing 30%. At levels 11 and 16 choose an upgrade.
champion.gangplank.passive.desc: Every 15s his next basic attack burns the target for 50–250 (by level) + 100% bonus AD (+2 per 1% Critical Strike chance) true damage over 2.5s and grants 15–30% Move Speed for 2s. Every Powder Keg explosion resets it and grants the Move Speed.
champion.gangplank.upgrade.title: Level {level}: upgrade Cannon Barrage
champion.gangplank.upgrade.dd.desc: After the first cluster a big cannonball lands in the center: a cluster's worth of true damage within 170 and a 75% slow for 1s.
champion.gangplank.upgrade.fire.desc: 18 waves instead of 12: a cluster of 3 every 1.33s.
champion.gangplank.upgrade.morale.desc: Inside the barrage you gain 40% Move Speed, lingering for 2s.
champion.orianna.name: Orianna
champion.orianna.title: the Lady of Clockwork
champion.orianna.Q.desc: Commands the Ball to fly to the target location (up to 825 units) and stay there, dealing magic damage to enemies it passes through and to enemies within 175 of where it lands. Enemies hit after the first take 70%. Restores 3 mana per enemy hit, up to its cost.
champion.orianna.W.desc: The Ball emits an electric pulse that deals magic damage to enemies within 225 and leaves a field for 3s: enemies inside are slowed by 20–40% and Orianna inside gains as much Move Speed, both fading over 2s after leaving it. Hitting 3 or more enemies refunds its mana cost.
champion.orianna.E.desc: Commands the Ball to fly back to Orianna and attach to her, dealing magic damage to enemies it passes through and granting her a Shield for 2.5s. While attached, the Ball grants her 6–30 Armor and Magic Resist.
champion.orianna.R.desc: After 0.5s, the Ball unleashes a shockwave that deals magic damage to enemies within 415, tosses them 325 units toward it and stuns them for 0.75s.
champion.orianna.passive.desc: Her basic attacks deal 10–50 (by level) + 15% AP bonus magic damage, and 15% more for each stack on the same target (up to 2 stacks, 4s; a new target starts over).
champion.twitch.name: Twitch
champion.twitch.title: the Plague Rat
champion.twitch.Q.desc: Grants 10% Move Speed for 10-14s and Attack Speed for 6s. Killing an elite or epic monster resets the cooldown.
champion.twitch.W.desc: Lobs a cask that bursts in a 300 radius: enemies hit gain a Deadly Venom stack and are slowed (+6% per 100 AP). The venom pool lasts 3s, slowing enemies inside and adding a stack each second (up to 4 per cask).
champion.twitch.E.desc: Needs a poisoned enemy within 1200. A toxin flies to each poisoned enemy: physical damage plus 25-55 (+50% bonus AD) physical and 50% AP magic damage per Deadly Venom stack (a poisoned enemy's death spreads its stacks within 300). The card shows 6 stacks.
champion.twitch.R.desc: For 6s gains bonus AD and 300 attack range; basic attacks fire bolts that pierce every enemy in line with on-hit effects, 10% less per enemy hit (down to 60%).
champion.twitch.passive.desc: Basic attacks and Venom Cask apply Deadly Venom for 6s (refreshed, up to 6 stacks): each stack deals 2/4/6/8/10 (levels 1/5/9/13/17) + 3% AP true damage every second. When a poisoned enemy dies, its stacks spread to every enemy within 300 units.
champion.udyr.name: Udyr
champion.udyr.title: the Spirit Walker
champion.udyr.Q.desc: Claw Stance: your next two attacks reach 50 farther and deal 3-8% (+3.5% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's max Health as physical damage. For 4s you gain Attack Speed and your attacks deal the bonus physical damage shown (+20% bonus AD +0.8-1.8% bonus Health). Awaken: 20-70% more Attack Speed, the empowered attacks deal 2-4% (+5% per 100 bonus AD) more max Health, and your next two attacks call lightning 6 times over 1s for 1.5-3% (+0.6% per 100 AP) of max Health magic damage, chaining between up to 3 nearby enemies.
champion.udyr.W.desc: Mantle Stance: your next two attacks life steal 15-20% and heal 1.2% max Health (+8% AP) on hit (60% against minions). You gain the shield shown (+2-3.5% max Health +40% AP +50% bonus AD) for 4s. Awaken: a second shield of 20-150 (by level) + the first +65% AP +8% max Health +100% bonus AD, half of it healed over 4s, and the empowered attacks heal twice as much.
champion.udyr.E.desc: Stampede Stance: your next two attacks pounce onto the target and stun it for 0.75s (once per target every 6-4s). For 4s you pass through enemies and gain the Move Speed shown (+5% per 100 bonus AD), decaying to 30% over 1.5s. Awaken: +75 attack range, 30-40% (by level) more Move Speed and immunity to crowd control for 1.5s.
champion.udyr.R.desc: Storm Stance: your next two attacks deal 10-40 (by level) +35% AP magic damage to enemies around the target. A blizzard follows you for 4s, dealing the magic damage shown every 0.5s to enemies within 370 and slowing them (minions take 50-80%). Awaken: the blizzard becomes a glacial storm that hunts the nearest enemy, adding 1-1.75% (+0.44% per 100 AP) max Health per tick and 5% more slow; the empowered attacks hit every enemy inside it.
champion.udyr.passive.desc: He has no ultimate: Q, W, E and R are stances, and casting one empowers his next two basic attacks. Recasting the current stance 0.25–5s after entering it Awakens it (cooldown 50/40/30/20s by level 1/6/11/16); the two attacks after any cast also gain 30% Attack Speed for 4s, and each refunds 5% of the Awaken cooldown.
champion.aurora.name: Aurora
champion.aurora.title: the Witch Between Worlds
champion.aurora.Q.desc: Fires cursed energy in a direction, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and cursing them for 3.5s. Recast (automatic when the curse ends): the curses fly back to Aurora, dealing magic damage to every enemy they pass through, up to 50% more by missing Health (75% against minions, 50% against monsters, 20% after the first bolt).
champion.aurora.W.desc: Hops 300 units in a direction and enters Realm Hopper for 4s: walks through units and gains the Move Speed shown, doubled for the first 1-1.6s (instead of League's invisibility). Killing an elite or epic monster resets the cooldown.
champion.aurora.E.desc: Blasts spirit magic in an 825-unit line, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies hit by 80%, decaying over 1s. Aurora then hops 250 units backward.
champion.aurora.R.desc: Leaps 250 units, then a shockwave expands ahead of her, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies by 30% for 2s. The rift stays for 2.25-3.25s and grants Realm Hopper for 3.25-4.25s: walking into its edge jumps Aurora across, and enemies crossing it are slowed by 50% for 1.5-2s. Recast after 1s to close it.
champion.aurora.passive.desc: Damaging basic attacks and abilities apply a stack for 4s (up to 3); the third consumes them for 1% (+2.7% per 100 AP) max Health magic damage (capped at 100–270 by level against monsters) and frees a Spirit that follows her for 4s (up to 4). Each Spirit heals her for 10–20 (by level) + 2% AP per second.
champion.hwei.name: Hwei
champion.hwei.title: the Visionary
champion.hwei.Q.desc: Opens Disaster: Devastating Fire hurls a fireball that explodes on the first enemy for magic damage plus 3-7% of max Health (up to 250 against monsters). Severing Bolt strikes the area after 1s for 60-160 (+30% AP), up to 200-350% against a lone or immobilized enemy by missing Health (75% to minions and monsters). Molten Fissure erupts 7 times along a path for 20-80 (+30% AP), leaving lava that slows by 35% and burns for 6-24 (+6% AP) every 0.25s for 2.5s.
champion.hwei.W.desc: Opens Serenity: Fleeting Current paints a current that gives 30-40% (+3% per 100 AP) Move Speed while you stand in it for 4-6s. Pool of Reflection shields you for half its amount on entering, growing to 100-260 (+60% AP) while you stay inside for 3s, and heals you for 30% of that amount as it grows. Stirring Lights: three flares empower your next 3 attacks or ability hits within 9s for the bonus magic damage shown, restoring 45-65 mana each.
champion.hwei.E.desc: Opens Torment: Grim Visage strikes the first enemy hit for magic damage and fears it for 1-1.5s, slowing it by 70-99% (farther, stronger). Gaze of the Abyss places an eye that launches itself at the nearest enemy, rooting the first one it meets for 1.2-2s. Crushing Maw snaps after 0.6s, pulling enemies to the center and slowing them by 40-70%, decaying over 1.25s.
champion.hwei.R.desc: Launches despair that sticks to the first enemy hit: for 3s a growing aura deals 10-30 (+5% AP) magic damage per second to enemies inside and slows them by 10% per stack (up to 12), then shatters for the damage shown. While in a mood, R is Wash Brush: leaves the mood without its cost or cooldown.
champion.hwei.passive.desc: Damaging abilities mark the enemies they hit for 4s. Another ability (not the same one, not the same cast) hitting a marked enemy consumes the mark: 0.85s later an explosion where it stood deals 40–285 (by level) + 35% AP magic damage within 285 units.
champion.kayle.name: Kayle
champion.kayle.title: the Righteous
champion.kayle.Q.desc: Opens a portal in front of her; after 0.25s a celestial sword flies from it and expands on the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage in a cross-shaped area, slowing by 25-45% for 2s and reducing Armor and Magic Resist by 15% for 4s.
champion.kayle.W.desc: Heals herself for 55-155 (+25% AP) and gains 24-40% (+8% per 100 AP) Move Speed for 2s.
champion.kayle.E.desc: Passive: her basic attacks deal bonus magic damage on-hit. Active: resets her basic attack; the next one within 5s deals 8-10% (+1.5% per 100 AP) of the target's missing Health as magic damage (up to 400 against monsters) and reaches 525 range before level 6. From level 11 it explodes on the target, hitting every enemy within 350.
champion.kayle.R.desc: Becomes invulnerable for 2.5s and conjures flaming swords, then rains them down around herself, dealing magic damage to every enemy within 675-775.
champion.kayle.passive.desc: Each attack grants Zeal for 5s (6% + 1% per 100 AP Attack Speed per stack, up to 5); at 5 stacks she is Exalted, gaining 10% Move Speed. At level 6 she attacks from 525 range; from level 11 Exalted attacks launch a wave of fire for 20 (+3 per level after 11) + 10% bonus AD + 25% AP magic damage; at level 16 her range is 625 and she is always Exalted.
champion.veigar.name: Veigar
champion.veigar.title: the Tiny Master of Evil
champion.veigar.Q.desc: Blasts a dark bolt that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. A kill grants 1 stack of Phenomenal Evil (3 against large minions and monsters).
champion.veigar.W.desc: Dark matter falls on the target area 1.2s after the cast starts, dealing magic damage to enemies within 240 units. Every 50 stacks of Phenomenal Evil cut its 8s cooldown by 10%.
champion.veigar.E.desc: After 0.5s, erects a cage at the target area for 3s. Enemies touching its edges are stunned for 1.5-2.5s (once per cast, at most every 4.5s per enemy).
champion.veigar.R.desc: Sends a primordial burst at the target enemy that deals magic damage, increased by 1.5% per 1% of its missing Health, up to double damage.
champion.veigar.passive.desc: Each stack gives 1 Ability Power, with no limit. Baleful Strike kills give 1 stack (3 against large minions and monsters); each ability hit on an elite or epic monster gives 1, and killing one gives 5.
champion.heimerdinger.name: Heimerdinger
champion.heimerdinger.title: the Revered Inventor
champion.heimerdinger.upgrade.ap.desc: This turret's shots and beam gain +{n} Ability Power.
champion.heimerdinger.upgrade.cleave.des: This turret's shots also deal {n}% of their damage to the other enemies within 350 of the target.
champion.heimerdinger.Q.desc: Builds a turret (up to 10) that shoots the enemies Heimerdinger hits, else the nearest, dealing magic damage (35% AP +1% per Heimerdinger level). Turrets slowly charge a beam that deals magic damage to every enemy in a line. Uses a Turret Kit (3, one every 20s); turrets shut down after 8s too far from him. Hextech Affinity: 20% Move Speed near his turrets. Q on one of his turrets levels it up instead (levels 1 to 10, one of three upgrades each).
champion.heimerdinger.W.desc: Fires 5 rockets that converge on the target area, each dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit; later rockets on the same enemy deal 10-30 (+12% AP), tripled against minions. Each rocket hitting an elite or epic monster charges nearby turrets by 20%.
champion.heimerdinger.E.desc: Hurls a grenade that deals magic damage within 250 units and Slows by 35% for 2s; enemies in the center are Stunned for 1.5s. Hitting an elite or epic monster fully charges nearby turrets.
champion.heimerdinger.R.desc: Upgrades the next basic ability, free of Mana: Apex Turret (8s, shots that hit an area and Slow by 25%, a fast-charging beam), Rocket Swarm (4 waves of 5 rockets) or Lightning Grenade (bounces 3 times, larger areas). Recast after 3s to cancel.
champion.heimerdinger.passive.desc: Gains 20% Move Speed while within 300 units of his turrets.
